title: Make deletion durable and resurrection-proof in memory stores (VC-201-083)
goal: VC-201-083 refuted: insert() never consults the tombstone set, so a late write after delete_resume permanently repopulates authoritative/index/cache/replica while the tombstone only shields get(); tombstones are volatile in-memory state with no persistence, so a restart forgets every deletion; and MemoryStores has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_083_mastery.rs.
